message:
Now I understand the fuzzer. The input is an XSLT stylesheet. The fuzzer loads a fixed XML document (`xslt.xml`) and applies the stylesheet to it. The stylesheet can call `crypto:rc4_decrypt` which returns invalid UTF-8 data.

Let me look at the seed corpus and the `xslt.xml` document to understand the input document.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>ls /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libxslt/tests/fuzz/seed/xslt/ 2>/dev/null && echo "---" && cat /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libxslt/tests/fuzz/xslt.xml 2>/dev/null</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
